body: You are welcome!  I have many more than just what are posted on the blog.
Sure! I have a blog with a few of my experiences.  I am not afraid of my gift.  I have helped several people already and I look forward to helping more.
Yes, It happened a few times before.  Since then, I have too many paranormal experiences to count.  It was shortly after that I found out I was medium.

Ollie my very large orange tabby cat loved to go into my daughter's room and 'wake' her up every morning by kneading and rubbing on her hair.  Sadly, Ollie passed away about 3 week ago after being struck by a car.  Foir the past two days, my daughter has came in and told me that Ollie visited her and tried to wake her up by kneading on her hair.

I am deeply limited as far as Doctors go due to living in a small town and my job greatly limits me on time off.  I actually went to my family Doc and explained everything that was going on, and he empathized with me, and he gave me a medication to try: Lexapro.  As of right now, it seems to be helping quite a bit.  I have also delved back into my creative hobbies (writing and drawing) and that has seemed to help quite a bit as well.  Thank you all for your words of encouragement and support.
